name: avatar
description:
Classes that style an or
around an as a round profile picture. CSS only: no fallback and no image loading state.

props.size: Add avatar--small, avatar--medium, or avatar--large by hand. Large is the default.
props.element: Use <a> for hover and focus styles. A <div> gets neither.

props.src: The picture. A broken image shows the browser's broken image icon.

modifiers.avatar--disabled: Lowers opacity and turns off pointer events

customPropertiesNote: Public variables use the --_op-avatar-* prefix and are set on .avatar. The size modifiers copy a size into the private --__op-avatar-size. Borders are two inset box shadows drawn in ::after, from separate color and width variables. Hover draws a tinted overlay in ::before. Hover and focus colors come straight from global tokens and have no avatar variable. The image is styled with an element selector (.avatar img), not a class.

avatar.--_op-avatar-hover-opacity: Opacity of the hover overlay. Not in the docs
avatar.--_op-avatar-size-large: Width and height for avatar--large and the default
